jobs.occupation: TYRE FITTERS WANTED FOR THE UPCOMING AUTUMN SEASON
jobs.description:
Are you hands-on, physically fit, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment? Then this might be the job for you.

We are currently looking for 2 tyre fitters for the upcoming tyre season in Amager. You will become part of a professional workshop where things get busy during the season, and where teamwork, efficiency, and quality are important.

Your responsibilities

As a tyre fitter, your tasks will include:

• 
Removing and fitting wheels and tyres

• 
Changing between summer and winter tyres

• 
Checking tyre pressure and the general condition of tyres

• 
Moving and handling wheels and tyres

• 
Preparing and cleaning the work area

• 
Potentially washing and registering customers' wheels

We are looking for someone who

• 
Is reliable, hardworking, and comfortable with physical work

• 
Can work efficiently while maintaining a high level of quality

• 
Is physically fit and able to handle lifting

• 
Can work independently as well as part of a team

• 
Is flexible regarding working hours during the busy season

• 
Speaks and understands Danish or English

Experience as a tyre fitter, mechanic, or in a similar position is an advantage, but not a requirement. Full training and instructions will be provided.

We offer

• 
Seasonal work during a busy and attractive period

• 
Good working conditions

• 
Thorough introduction and training

• 
A good working environment and great colleagues

• 
Competitive salary according to the 3F collective agreement

• 
Full-time work as a starting point, with the possibility of additional working hours during the peak season

Employment period

This is a temporary seasonal position related to the autumn tyre change season. The exact employment period and working hours will be agreed upon.

Interested?

Send your application or a short description of yourself and your experience as soon as possible.

Phone: +45 53 53 11 99

jobs.description:
Leder du efter et job, hvor der hele tiden er gang i den, men hvor du samtidig har frihe-

den til at sætte dit eget præg?

Asien Restaurant Søger lige nu en kok, der kan tiltræde hurtigst muligt. Vi er en kinesisk

restaurant, der laver a la carte på menuen.

Om jobbet:
- Have det overordnede ansvar i køkkenet
- Forberedelse af maden til a la

carte og take away
- Planlægge menu
- Lave vagtplaner, fordele arbejdsopgaver, osv.

Kvalifikationer:

- Være uddannet kok og/eller have erfaring i en lignende stilling i mindst 5 år.
- Køkken-

færdigheder.
- Vant til et køkken og kan holde hovedet koldt under pres.
- Imødekom-

mende.
- Kan arbejde både i hverdage + weekenden.
- Taler enten dansk, engelsk eller

meget gerne kinesisk.

* Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt

Lyder dette som noget for dig? Tøv ikke med at sende en ansøgning og CV til

ch270805@hotmail.com

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

----- English ----
AsianRestaurant ,we’re now hiring a chef who can help us feed our custo-

mers.

Are you looking for a job where the speed is on top while it’s still possible to be creative?

We’re a Chinese restaurant that serve a la carte on the menu.

Therefore, you can always expect to have something to do while having the freedom to

be creative.

We are looking for a person who can start with immediate effect.

About the job:
- You will have the full responsibility of the kitchen.
- Prepare the food for

the a la carte and take away.
- Plan the menu.
- Plan the work schedule for your team,

assigning work to colleagues, etc.

Qualifications:
- Educated chef with experience for at least 5 years.

- Kitchen skills.
- Used to work in a kitchen and being able to cope with pressure.
- Open-

minded.
- Able to work for several hours in weekdays and weekend.
- Can speak either

Danish, English or preferably Mandarin Chinese.

* The position is for 37 hours per week.

If you’re interested, feel free to send an application and CV to ch270805@hotmail.com
